notes.title: The Dungeon is now open!
notes.content:
To all adventurers!
The Dungeon has opened!

Special rewards for retrieving any Artifact, if present.

The Guild does not take responsibility for any injuries or deaths.
Veteran adventurers are preferable for this quest.

Best of luck,
Adventurer's Guild

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670900/Dungeon_Core_Master/

The Guild would like to remind previous adventurers, that a special discount is available!
It could be also a great opportunity to explore other tales and mythos!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25882/games_by_artoonu/


---------------

Hi!
I hope you'll enjoy this one. Experimentally, I've decided to split the story at a certain point and dedicate it to each character so you could get closer... much closer to them during different story arcs!
Another new thing compared to my previous games, is the introduction of a named, visible main character!
Let me know what you think of these new ideas. What did you like? What did you not like? Only through constructive criticism I can understand in which direction should I go.

As for my next project... I'm already working on something... BIG. Something I've never tried before. Something exciting, fresh, different. It's thanks to your support all this time I can slowly try making more and more ambitious projects. I hope to not disappoint you!

~artoonu

notes.title: A new Dungeon will soon open!
notes.content:
To all adventurers!
It came to our attention that a new Dungeon has become active.
Your mission will be to investigate it.

Everyone interested should Wishlist at the nearest Terminal and await further information.
We anticipate the Dungeon will open soon.

Kind regards,
Adventurer's Guild

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670900/Dungeon_Core_Master/

---------------

Hi!
The game is completed and you can expect it released... Sooner than you think :)
As you know, I don't like giving precise dates due to various circumstances that can happen.
Heck, sometimes I'm not sure myself when I'll hit that "Release" button :P

This time, I invite you to delve into the depths of the mysterious Dungeon...

~artoonu
